item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Mindset. Your day is loaded with check-ins on how you're thinking, not just what you're doing: a morning perspective practice, a meditation session, a stress contemplation exercise, and a prompt to catch yourself projecting or mind-reading. That's a lot of self-monitoring, which is good, but it can tip into overthinking if you're not careful. Pick one moment today to actually pause and ask whether this moment supports the life you're building. Do that one check with intention, not autopilot.
